title: The Yellow Card — EN/ES/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational soccer philosophy 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish German language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The yellow card is produced from the breast pocket of the man
Who has decided that your contribution to this plan
Was slightly over the acceptable and needs to be addressed
By a rectangle of laminated yellow — you're assessed

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La tarjeta amarilla sale del bolsillo del árbitro
[The yellow card comes from the referee's pocket]
Un rectángulo oficial que da el mensaje sin equívoco
[An official rectangle that gives the message without ambiguity]
El jugador mira sus botas — como si las botas fueran culpables
[The player looks at his boots — as if the boots were guilty]
Pero la tarjeta ya está fuera, los hechos son inescapables
[But the card is already out, the facts are inescapable]

[Chorus — English]
The yellow card says something nobody needs to say
You've been noted and recorded and it doesn't go away
The yellow card is official now — it's in the book and done
You have one more before the red and then you're gone, son
That's my boy

[Bridge — German, with English translation]
Die Gelbe Karte kommt aus der Brusttasche des Schiedsrichters
[The yellow card comes from the referee's breast pocket]
Ein kleines Rechteck das sagt: du bist ein Überschreiter
[A small rectangle that says: you are a transgressor]
Der Spieler schaut auf seine Schuhe — als ob die Schuhe wüssten
[The player looks at his shoes — as if the shoes would know]
Aber die Karte ist draußen und die Fakten nicht zu küssen
[But the card is out and the facts cannot be ignored]

[Outro — All three languages]
The yellow card knows… La tarjeta amarilla sabe… Die Gelbe Karte weiß
Noted and recorded — Anotado y registrado — Notiert und aufgezeichnet
That's my boy
